title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E08 — Neon Terror
The BAU is called in to investigate when a criminal sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E09 — False Flag
The BAU is called to investigate when two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, N.M., perish in quick succession.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E10 — Submerged
When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team searches for an UnSub who has a puzzling past.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E11 — Full-Tilt Boogie
The BAU team's investigation into the home invasion and attempted homicide of a police chief's wife uncovers a world of secrets in a small town in Virginia.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E12 — Bad moon on the Rise
The BAU is called to New York when several casualties of a brutal nature are reported in Central Park.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E13 — Cure
The BAU is called to investigate a series of homicides in which cryptic messages are found inside the mouths of the victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E14 — Miasma
The BAU is called when the New Orleans Police Department discovers a mass grave inside a vandalized above-ground crypt in a local cemetery.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E15 — Annihilator
The FBI's assistant director of national security joins the BAU as it investigates the quadruple homicide of a group of roommates in St. Louis.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E16 — Last Gasp
The BAU meets in secret to investigate a subject who appears to be kidnapping and photographing young women.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E17 — The Capilanos
The BAU is called to Oklahoma to investigate a murderous clown who is terrorizing a town.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E18 — The Dance of Love
The BAU travels to Chicago to investigate a case where red roses are left on victims; Rossi gets an unexpected visit from his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E19 — Ex Parte
The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm where Matt Simmons' wife works.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E18 — Reaper
Remy and the team investigate the homicides of two Army veterans in a murder spree connected to their time in Afghanistan; Hana receives surprising news about her birth mother.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E09 — Code + Artemis + Nuclear + N3mesis
Los Angeles' power grid is taken hostage in a ransomware attack resulting in a citywide blackout; the team discovers the ransomware code used was written by Riley years ago.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E10 — Tesla + Bell + Edison + Mac
When Mac is put into a dream state to help him recall key evidence found in Nikola Tesla's secret lab that could stop Codex's deadly plot, he encounters Nikola Tesla, Alexander Graham Bell, Thomas Edison and his mother.

title: MacGyver
description:
S04 E11 — Psy-Op + Cell + Merchant + Birds
Mac is placed inside a fake prison cell with a top Codex operative, "The Merchant," to gain his trust and get intel on their next move.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E14 — Shattered
The team pursues an abusive man who is on the hunt for an ex-girlfriend trying to escape him; Jess and Sarah make plans to take their dream vacation together.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E15 — Incel
The team must track down a murderous member of the incel community targeting those he believes never give him a chance; Barnes, Hana, Ortiz and Kristin deal with their grief in the wake of Jess' death.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E16 — Decriminalized
The team gets called to Vermont after a married couple who grow illegal marijuana massacre their employees; Barnes begins to regret not taking any time off to bond with her new baby.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E17 — Covenant
Charming but formidable Supervisory Special Agent Remy Scott arrives to lead the team as they investigate a series of homicides tied to a forbidden love between a young teen and her older boyfriend.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E18 — Reaper
Remy and the team investigate the homicides of two Army veterans in a murder spree connected to their time in Afghanistan; Hana receives surprising news about her birth mother.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E05 — The Truth in the Lye
Booth and Brennan probe what appears to be a case of jealousy and insurance money when a man is found dead at a construction site, but new clues send them in a different direction.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E06 — The Girl in Suite 2103
Brennan and Booth investigate an explosion in a Miami hotel where a young woman had burned to death.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E07 — The Girl With the Curl
Brennan and Booth investigate a young beauty queen's remains that are discovered at a water filtration plant; Hodgins asks Angela out on a date, which she accepts.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E08 — The Woman in the Sand
The skeletal remains of a federal prosecutor, who disappeared five years earlier, are discovered in the desert outside Las Vegas; an anonymous lead takes Booth and Brennan to the world of gambling and underground ultimate fighting.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E09 — Aliens in a Spaceship
Booth and Brennan search for a killer who buries his victims alive and leaves them to die if ransom demands are not met.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E10 — The Headless Witch in the Woods
Brennan and Booth investigate when a headless corpse appears in the woods along with a frightening videotape of events on the night of the murder.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E11 — Judas on a Pole
Brennan and Booth investigate the case of a mutilated body found on the roof of a federal building; Brennan hears from her long-lost father.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E12 — The Man in the Cell
A body Brennan and Booth think is that of Brennan's incarcerated adversary, serial killer Howard Epps, is burned beyond recognition.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E13 — The Girl in the Gator
After Booth's gun is taken away because he maliciously shot a clown ornament on an ice-cream truck, Brennan must go to Florida alone to investigate the death of a college student whose body is found inside an alligator.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E14 — Man in the Mansion
The Bancroft family calls on Brennan and Booth to investigate the stabbing death of Terence Bancroft; Agent Sullivan invites Brennan to his basketball game.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E15 — Bodies in the Book
During a murder investigation at the marina, Booth notices similarities between the case and a murder in Brennan's latest book.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E16 — The Boneless Bride in the River
Booth interrupts Brennan's vacation with her boyfriend to get help with the case of a woman whose boneless body was found in a river.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E17 — The Priest in the Churchyard
When a water main bursts at a cemetery, Brennan must identify and help reinter the remains that litter the grounds.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E18 — The Killer in the Concrete
Booth suspects an organized-crime family when a partial skeleton is found encased in concrete, and he tries to lure the suspected killer out of hiding; Brennan gets a surprise visit from her father (Ryan O'Neal) while visiting her mother's grave.

title: Bones
description:
S02 E19 — Spaceman in a Crater
When Brennan and Booth investigate a body that was found in a crater, evidence suggests that it had been in outer space.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E03 — Diplomatic Immunity
The team investigates the murder of a Navy intelligence officer killed during a conference for foreign diplomats; Pride has some trouble adjusting to his new position at the agency.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E04 — Legacy
An investigation into the murder of a petty officer reveals a conspiracy in a tight-knit local fishing community; LaSalle awaits the final results of the tax fraud investigation into his family's company.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E05 — In the Blood
Pride's father, Cassius Pride, is wrapped up in an NCIS case involving a notorious unsolved casino heist; Pride meets a family member he never knew existed.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E06 — Pound of Flesh
After Pride's assistant escapes from a kidnapper, the team uncovers evidence of a suspect who is harvesting organs from multiple victims; Pride turns to a friend for guidance as he struggles with the ramifications of his recent brush with death.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E07 — Sheepdogs
Following a deadly car explosion in the French Quarter, the team interrogates a professor and former member of a student protest organization; Tammy discovers a secret about Hannah's personal life.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E08 — Close to Home
The team places Mateo Diaz, a high school gang member turned informant, in protective custody while they investigate the murder of his junior reserve officers' training corps instructor; Pride needs his brother's help to gain Mateo's trust.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E09 — Risk Assessment
The team investigates the murder of a Navy contractor who secretly lived two lives for decades.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S05 E10 — Tick Tock
Pride is given a series of tasks to complete by unknown assailants who are holding Wade and his father hostage.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E21 — He Kama Na Ka Pueo
A murdered man's body may hold the key to a 20-year-old case involving a kidnapped girl whose father never stopped looking for her.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E22 — O Ke Kumu, O Ka Mana, Ho'opuka 'Ia
Adam investigates the murder of an undercover FBI agent who was about to wed the daughter of a Yakuza leader; Noelani is held hostage and forced, along with her mentor Dr. Chu, to operate at gunpoint on a criminal.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E23 — Ho'okahi No La O Ka Malihini
McGarrett helps his sister spy on her shady neighbors; a ride-share driver and his passenger are murdered; the team teases the youngest members when Junior escorts Tani to a wedding.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E24 — Hewa Ka Lima
Fugitive hacker Aaron Wright resurfaces to ask for help when his co-workers at the NSA are murdered; Junior speaks at the parole hearing of the drunken driver who killed his sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E25 — Hana Mao 'ole ka ua o Waianae
Five-0 continues to hunt down escaped criminal Aaron Wright before he can sell cyber-weapons to the highest bidder; the lives of McGarrett and the team members are put in danger when a visitor comes to headquarters to make amends.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E01 — Ua 'eha Ka 'ili I Ka Maka O Ka Ihe
A new ally helps McGarrett and the team when mob bosses on the island are targeted by an assassin; the team says goodbye to one of its own.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E02 — Kuipeia E Ka Makani Apaa
Tani and Junior must plot an escape for themselves and several civilians after they become trapped inside a deadly tunnel collapse; Eddie the dog sniffs out a bomb that has been planted in McGarrett's home.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E03 — E Uhi Ana Ka Wa I Hala I Na Mea I Hala
A plane that mysteriously crashed into the Pacific in the '80s is found, but with a recently murdered scuba diver inside; McGarrett and Quinn zero in on who planted the bomb in his garage; McGarrett formally asks Quinn to join the team.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E04 — Ukuli'i ka Pua, Onaona i ka Mau'u
Five-0 enlists imprisoned hacker Aaron Wright to help when a young girl is reported kidnapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E05 — He 'oi'o Kuhihewa; He Kaka ola i 'ike 'ia e ka Makaula
The team investigates a home invasion that turned deadly after a dangerous "monster" escaped from the basement; Max returns to Oahu with a very special guest.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E06 — A'ohe Pau ka 'ike i ka Halau Ho'okahi
A deadly hit-and-run involves a driverless car carrying heroin; Tani and Quinn are stuck with a pair of YouTubers who are brought on a ride-along.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E07 — Ka 'i'o
When the CIA informs McGarrett that his mother has gone rogue on her undercover mission and may have killed her partner, Steve goes to Mexico to bring her home and prove her innocence.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E08 — Ne'e aku, ne'e mai ke one o Punahoa
The team searches for a killer whose plane crashed in the jungle with $10 million worth of heroin on board; Grover is thrilled when his niece Siobhan comes to try out for the University of Hawaii basketball team.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E09 — Ka la'au kumu 'ole o Kahilikolo
Junior and Tani track down the thief who robbed his parents' home; Five-0 investigates the murder of a beloved philanthropist and the theft of his valuable koa tree; Danny moves in with McGarrett.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E10 — O 'Oe, a 'Owau, Nalo Ia Mea
When Adam's girlfriend is kidnapped right in front of him, he shuts out Five-0 and breaks all the rules in order to get her back; the team investigates three seemingly unconnected homicides.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S10 E11 — Ka I Ka 'Ino, No Ka 'Ino
A tourist helicopter is shot down by a missile; a search for stolen artillery leads to a ghost from McGarrett's past -- Wo Fat; Adam makes a bold decision about his future with Five-0.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E11 — House of Horrors
An actor is murdered while filming an alleged cursed horror movie.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E12 — False I.D.
The police superintendent interferes with the capture of a murder suspect.

title: The Listener
description:
S04 E13 — Fatal Vision
Toby struggles with PTSD after killing a suspect while the IIB attempts to stop an assassination.

title: The Listener
description:
S05 E01 — The Wrong Man
A serial killer imitates a past murderer; while on maternity leave, Michelle must return to the IIB in order to save her reputation.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E13 — Return of the King
After thousands of classified government files are stolen, the NCIS team searches for an underground group of hackers who were co-founded by Elvis Bertrand, Pride's old contact.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E14 — Pandora's Box, Part II
NCIS agents McGee and Torres head to New Orleans to partner with Pride and his team in the search for the missing homeland security theoretical terror playbook.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E15 — End of the Line
Painful memories come flooding back when a gruesome copycat murder leads to the reopening of a case for Wade.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E16 — The Last Stand
Pride's longtime friend, state and military attorney Rita Devereaux, asks NCIS to investigate the disappearance of a JAG lawyer who specializes in classified cases and volunteers at a private military academy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E17 — Swift, Silent, Deadly
A highly skilled special operations Marine assaults six men in a bar, sending the NCIS team on a city-wide manhunt.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E18 — Slay the Dragon
Tammy is reunited with her ex-husband, Ethan McKinley - who embezzled millions in Katrina relief funds - after he's tied to the murder of a crime boss' son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E19 — Quid Pro Quo
A deadly accident at a naval base exposes a unit of Seabees to a super virus and leaves the rest of the base and the city of New Orleans at risk for an outbreak; Wade is infected with the virus and given hours to live.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E20 — NOLA Confidential
LaSalle must investigate his former partner in the Vice unit after the NCIS team finds a link between an international drug ring and the New Orleans Police Department; Rita looks into a connection between the mayor and illegal activity in Clearwater.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E21 — Krewe
Pride listens in on a wiretap of Mayor Hamilton; the NCIS team investigates when Navy weapons get stolen in a train heist; featuring musical performances by Sheryl Crow.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E22 — Knockout
The murder of a Navy chaplain leads Pride to uncover a possible connection between Mayor Hamilton and illegal activity taking place in the city of Clearwater; Percy continues to face repercussions of her choices on a previous case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E23 — Down the Rabbit Hole
When Pride is spotted tracking one of Mayor Hamilton's accomplices on a crowded street, the suspect opens fire, putting innocent lives at risk before disappearing.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E24 — Poetic Justice
Unable to trust anyone in New Orleans, the NCIS team calls in FBI Assistant Director Isler to help expose and stop Mayor Hamilton's sinister scheme.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E01 — Rogue Nation
While Pride remains on probation after his rogue takedown of the corrupt Mayor Hamilton, his team is closely monitored by a strict supervisor; the team must secretly investigate after the FBI takes the lead on a case involving stolen nuclear waste.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E02 — No. 1 Fan
An erratic whistleblower who calls Pride her mentor kidnaps him to help her locate a serial killer targeting young women in the Gulf of Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E09 — Chasing Ghosts
The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S02 E10 — Billy and the Kid
A Marine's murder reveals new clues in the first case LaSalle and Pride worked together; a Thanksgiving celebration at Pride's bar.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E03 — The Asset
The team joins forces with FBI Director Isler after a Russian operative with intelligence on sleeper agents disappears; Tammy partners with former sleeper agent Eva Azarova to assist in the disappearance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E04 — Dead Man Calling
The team investigates the copycat murder of an unsolved case from 150 years ago that spawned a legendary ghost story; Gregorio is spooked when the case is connected to a recent séance and a local medium.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E05 — Viral
Sebastian is placed on administrative leave after being questioned by the FBI about a foot chase; Pride and the team attempt to clear Sebastian's name.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S04 E06 — Acceptable Loss
The murder of a petty officer leads the team to a woman who is targeting men with high security clearance; LaSalle's father arrives to discuss the family business.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E19 — Whack Job
The team goes after the killer of a man in witness protection, but finds there's more to the case than meets the eye; Remy is challenged by what he discovers when he reconnects with his mother.
